note: Numbers are spelled out on purpose: the model reads digits inconsistently, and the verifier compares what it actually said against this script word for word.

direction._: calm, warm, unhurried; one person speaking to one person in a quiet room
direction.enter: welcoming and low, almost confiding; nothing is being sold
direction.morning: brisk and practical, a working voice; slight forward pressure, never alarmed
direction.freeze: quiet and open, straight after a noise stops; a real question, not a challenge
direction.reflection: gentle and curious; the listener is not being assessed
direction.transition: even and kind; setting something down before picking something up
direction.context: plain and factual, an assistant reading a list
direction.ai: level and neutral; observing a limit, not criticising a machine
direction.second: the same practical voice as the morning, with less pressure
direction.mirror: steady and non-judgemental; whichever of these is true, it is not a verdict
direction.signal: deliberate, giving a name to something already felt
direction.noise: measured, slightly weary of the noise
direction.lens: warm then serious; the last line is an instruction to keep something, not to drop it
direction.system: quiet and direct, a small confession; never triumphant, never sly
direction.phenomena: even and explanatory, naming two things once
direction.pulseback: soft and generous, letting someone else be right
direction.final: slow and spacious, the end of a long thought; the last line is asked, not pressed
direction.end: quiet close, then one step forward
direction.name: one word, said plainly, as if reading a name off a list; a small pause at the end
direction.you: warm and neutral, handing something back rather than announcing it
direction.ready: unhurried, an invitation with no pressure in it at all

en.enter-4: Choose what makes sense to you.
en.morning: Your morning is already moving. You have thirty seconds. Choose the two things you would deal with first.
en.transition-1: You made a choice with the context you had.
en.transition-2: Now let us add what you could not see.
en.context: The same information, with what sat underneath it.
en.ai-2: AI can only reason from what it can see.
en.second: Same morning. More context. You have fifteen seconds. Choose two again.
en.mirror: Your experience did not change. The information available to you did.
en.signal-1: Signal. Information that changes what needs to happen next.
en.signal-2: Something can be important without requiring your attention right now.
en.noise: More information does not always create more clarity.
en.lens-2: But every lens has a boundary.
en.lens-3: Lens Lock. When one useful perspective becomes the only perspective.
en.system-4: The information was part of the experience. So was the way it reached you.
en.phenomena-1: Noise Gravity. When what is loud pulls attention.
en.phenomena-2: Signalfall. When what matters gets buried.
en.pulseback: Someone else may have chosen differently. And they may have had a good reason.
en.final-1: This was not about finding the right two messages.
en.final-2: It was about noticing what makes something feel important.
en.final-3: We do not all notice the same things. That is not always a problem.
en.final-4: The problem begins when we assume everyone sees what we see.
en.final-5: Reality is larger than any one lens.
en.final-6: What might you be seeing clearly, but only through your own lens?
en.end: Pulse One complete. Signal. But noticing something does not make it true.
en.ready: Take your time. Continue when you are ready.
en.mirror-both: More context changed what deserved your attention.
en.mirror-one: Some instincts held. One changed with context.
en.mirror-none: More context reinforced your first judgment.
en.context-2: Each one now shows who owns it, what it needs, and what happens if it waits.
en.noise-hero: High activity is not the same as high signal.
en.lens-hero: Bring your experience. But do not mistake it for the whole picture.
en.end-next: Next Pulse. Truth. What do you trust?

id.enter-4: Pilih yang paling masuk akal bagimu.
id.morning: Pagi harimu sudah mulai berjalan. Kamu punya tiga puluh detik. Pilih dua hal yang akan kamu tangani lebih dulu.
id.transition-1: Kamu membuat pilihan dengan konteks yang kamu punya.
id.transition-2: Sekarang, mari tambahkan yang tadi belum terlihat.
id.context: Informasi yang sama, dengan apa yang ada di baliknya.
id.ai-2: AI hanya dapat menalar dari informasi yang tersedia baginya.
id.second: Pagi yang sama. Konteks yang lebih lengkap. Kamu punya lima belas detik. Pilih dua lagi.
id.mirror: Pengalamanmu tidak berubah. Informasi yang tersedia untukmu yang berubah.
id.signal-1: Signal. Informasi yang mengubah apa yang perlu terjadi selanjutnya.
id.signal-2: Sesuatu bisa penting tanpa harus membutuhkan perhatianmu saat ini.
id.noise: Lebih banyak informasi tidak selalu menghasilkan lebih banyak kejelasan.
id.lens-1: Sebuah sudut pandang membantu kita melihat.
id.lens-2: Tetapi setiap sudut pandang memiliki batas.
id.lens-3: Lens Lock. Saat satu sudut pandang yang berguna menjadi satu-satunya sudut pandang.
id.system-2: Ada satu hal lain yang ikut memengaruhi.
id.system-4: Informasinya adalah bagian dari pengalaman. Begitu juga cara informasi itu sampai kepadamu.
id.phenomena-1: Noise Gravity. Saat yang paling berisik menarik perhatian.
id.phenomena-2: Signalfall. Saat yang penting tenggelam di antara informasi lain.
id.pulseback: Orang lain mungkin memilih hal yang berbeda. Dan mereka mungkin punya alasan yang masuk akal.
id.final-1: Ini bukan tentang menemukan dua pesan yang paling benar.
id.final-2: Ini tentang menyadari apa yang membuat sesuatu terasa penting.
id.final-3: Kita tidak selalu memperhatikan hal yang sama. Itu tidak selalu menjadi masalah.
id.final-4: Masalah dimulai ketika kita menganggap semua orang melihat apa yang kita lihat.
id.final-5: Realitas lebih besar dari satu sudut pandang.
id.final-6: Apa yang saat ini terlihat sangat jelas bagimu, tetapi mungkin hanya dari sudut pandangmu?
id.end: Pulse Satu selesai. Signal. Tetapi memperhatikan sesuatu tidak otomatis membuatnya benar.
id.you-context: Setelah ada konteks tambahan, kamu memilih.
id.ready: Tidak perlu buru-buru. Lanjut kalau sudah siap.
id.mirror-both: Konteks tambahan mengubah apa yang menurutmu perlu diperhatikan.
id.mirror-one: Sebagian pilihanmu tetap. Satu berubah setelah mendapat konteks tambahan.
id.context-2: Sekarang setiap informasi menunjukkan siapa pemiliknya, apa yang dibutuhkan, dan apa akibatnya jika ditunda.
id.noise-hero: Aktivitas yang tinggi tidak sama dengan signal yang tinggi.
id.lens-hero: Bawa pengalamanmu. Tetapi jangan anggap itu sebagai seluruh gambaran.
id.end-next: Pulse berikutnya. Truth. Apa yang kamu percaya?
